game.howto.1.text: Ten questions, one by one. Tap one plate, or press A to D (or 1 to 4). Answer before the clock finish.

game.howto.2.text: The faster you answer correct, the more points you go get. Wrong answer or time up, no point.

game.howto.3.text: Answer correct plenty times for row to build streak: x2 for 3 in a row, x3 for 5, x5 for 8. If you miss, e break.

game.howto.4.text: Three lifeline, one time each for one round: 50/50 comot two wrong answer, Skip change the question, Ask your padi show wetin people vote (padi fit wrong o!). Keys: F, S, H, or L for the next one.

game.howto.5.text: Quiz Duel: you go race one CPU contestant. Una two go answer the same question, and who answer correct first go score more. Daily Challenge: same ten questions for everybody today, one scored try for one day. P or Esc na pause.
